verdict: Ads are running but the funnel isn't converting — zero leads this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 294 clicks and spent $142.84, but produced zero leads — every visitor who clicked dropped off before completing a form. The root cause is a breakdown in the conversion path: landing pages and form tracking were not fully live when spend began, meaning the traffic had nowhere to convert. We are resolving the landing page and tracking setup now so that clicks have a functioning destination. Once that infrastructure is confirmed live, you should begin seeing leads register against this spend next period.
